newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies end sharply higher, Mar limit up.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies end sharply higher, Mar limit up.

text.p: CME pork belly futures closed sharply higher, with March rising its 3.00-cent limit in the closing minutes.
Traders said activation of buy stops produced the late gains. March also drew support from traders transferring long February positions to March.
Traders said the late gains did not appear to be tied to cash market developments. USDA reported cash belly prices were steady at midday.
CME pork bellies closed up 2.800 to 1.225 cents, with March up most at 78.550 cents a lb and February 1.675 cents higher at 77.900 cents.
